newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Stan Chart, Prudential US in equities deal.
newsitem.headline: Stan Chart, Prudential US in equities deal.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank and Prudential Securities Inc have entered a strategic relationship on equity raising transactions for clients in Asia, the companies said in a joint statement on Monday.

Under the arrangement, Stan Chart's corporate finance teams would orginate and execute transactions including initial public offerings (IPOs), secondary fund raisings and distributed placements, it said.

Prudential Securities' distribution teams -- Prudential-Bache in Asia and Prudential Securities elsewhere -- would distribute resultant equity and equity-related products to their investor clients in Asia and worldwide.
Both companies have substantial operations in Hong Kong and elsewhere in Asia.
Prudential Securities is a unit of The Prudential Insurance Co of America.
